title: Fast and Parallel High-Rate STAR Architecture for Megaquop Quantum Simulation
abstract: A fast, parallel, high-rate STAR (space-time-adaptive) architecture for fault-tolerant 'megaquop' quantum simulation on neutral atoms. Gives a concrete ~2,240 physical-qubit budget (~200 s/shot, ~5.5x space reduction vs surface-code STAR) for FT simulation of the 8x8 transverse-field Ising model.
key_claims: ~2,240 physical qubits for FT simulation of the 8x8 TFIM (same spin model as HYP-008/HYP-027).
Digital FT route to static holographic-force observables sidesteps the analog hologron-decay killer (R1) that shelved HYP-017.
Companion paper arXiv:2509.18294 (transversal STAR) is a required input and is uncatalogued.
